title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
ECB hiked +25bp to 2.50% deposit rate (12:15 GMT) — Eurozone CPI 3.3% Aug, energy +14.3% YoY.
FOMC Sep 16 hike odds tick to ~66% (CME) post-ECB; US Aug CPI prints tomorrow 08:30 ET (cons. 3.4% YoY).
BTC $77.9K / ETH $2.46K — pre-CPI drift; 24h moves within thresholds.
